H200.def: from the same as «0191»; silliness:--folly, foolishly(-ness).

H201.def: from «0559»; talkative; Omar, a grandson of Esau:--Omar.

H202.et: probably from the same as (0205) (in the sense of effort, but successful)
H202.def: probably from the same as «0205» (in the sense of effort, but successful); ability, power, (figuratively) wealth:--force, goods, might, strength, substance.

H203.def: the same as «0202»; On, an Israelite:--On.

H204.def: or (shortened); On {one}; of Egyptian derivation; On, a city of Egypt:--On.

H205.et: from an unused root perhaps meaning properly, to pant (hence, to exert oneself, usually in vain
H205.def: from an unused root perhaps meaning properly, to pant (hence, to exert oneself, usually in vain; to come to naught); strictly nothingness; also trouble. vanity, wickedness; specifically an idol:--affliction, evil, false, idol, iniquity, mischief, mourners(-ing), naught, sorrow, unjust, unrighteous, vain ,vanity, wicked(-ness). Compare «0369».

H206.def: the same as «0205»; idolatry; Aven, the contemptuous synonym of three places, one in Coele-Syria, one in Egypt (On), and one in Palestine (Bethel):--Aven. See also «0204», «01007».

H207.def: or (shortened) ;Onow {o-no'}; prolonged from «0202»; strong; Ono, a place in Palestine:--Ono.

H208.def: a variation of «0209»; strong; Onam, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite:--Onam.

H209.def: a variation of «0207»; strong; Onan, a son of Judah:--Onan.

H210.def: perhaps a corruption of «0211»; Uphaz, a famous gold region:--Uphaz.

H211.def: or (shortened) pOphiyr {o-feer'}; and fOwphir {o- feer'}; of uncertain derivation; Ophir, the name of a son of Joktan, and of a gold region in the East:--Ophir.

H212.et: from an unused root meaning to revolve
H212.def: or (shortened) pophan {o-fawn'}; from an unused root meaning to revolve; a wheel:--wheel.

H213.def: a primitive root; to press; (by implication) to be close, hurry, withdraw:--(make) haste(-n, -y), labor, be narrow.

H214.def: from «0686»; a depository:--armory, cellar, garner, store(-house), treasure(-house) (-y).

H215.def: a primitive root; to be (causative, make) luminous (literally and metaphorically):--X break of day, glorious, kindle, (be, en-, give, show) light (-en, -ened), set on fire, shine.

H216.def: from «0215»; illumination or (concrete) luminary (in every sense, including lightning, happiness, etc.):--bright, clear, + day, light (-ning), morning, sun.

H217.def: from «0215»; flame; hence (in the plural) the East (as being the region of light):--fire, light. See also «0224».

H218.def: the same as «0217»; Ur, a place in Chaldaea; also an Israelite:--Ur.

H219.def: feminine of «0216»; luminousness, i.e. (figuratively) prosperity; also a plant (as being bright):--herb, light.

H221.def: from «0217»; fiery; Uri, the name of three Israelites:--Uri.

H222.def: from «0217» and «0410»; flame of God; Uriel, the name of two Israelites:--Uriel.

H223.def: or (prolonged) Uwriyahuw {oo-ree-yaw'-hoo}; from «0217» and «03050»; flame of Jah; Urijah, the name of one Hittite and five Israelites:--Uriah, Urijah.

H224.def: plur of «0217»; lights; Urim, the oracular brilliancy of the figures in the high-priest's breastplate:--Urim.

H225.def: a primitive root; properly, to come, i.e. (implied) to assent:--consent.

H226.et: probably from (0225) (in the sense of appearing)
H226.def: probably from «0225» (in the sense of appearing); a signal (literally or figuratively), as a flag, beacon, monument, omen, prodigy, evidence, etc.:--mark, miracle, (en-)sign, token.

H227.def: a demonstrative adverb; at that time or place; also as a conjunction, therefore:--beginning, for, from, hitherto, now, of old, once, since, then, at which time, yet.

H228.def: (Aramaic) or iazah (Aramaic) {az-aw'}; to kindle; (by implication) to heat:--heat, hot.

H229.def: probably from «0231»; hyssop-like; Ezbai, an Israelite:--Ezbai.

H232.def: from «0246»; something girt; a belt, also a band:--girdle.

H234.def: from «02142»; a reminder; specifically remembrance- offering:--memorial.

H235.def: a primitive root; to go away, hence, to disappear:--fail, gad about, go to and fro (but in Ezek. 27:19 the word is rendered by many "from Uzal," by others "yarn"), be gone (spent).

H237.def: from «0235»; departure; Ezel, a memorial stone in Palestine:--Ezel.

H238.def: a primitive root; probably to expand; but used only as a denominative from «0241»; to broaden out the ear (with the hand), i.e. (by implication) to listen:--give (perceive by the) ear, hear(-ken). See «0239».

H239.et: a primitive root [rather identical with (0238) through the idea of scales as if two ears]
H239.def: a primitive root (rather identical with «0238» through the idea of scales as if two ears); to weigh, i.e. (figuratively) ponder:--give good head.

H240.def: from «0238»; a spade or paddle (as having a broad end):--weapon.

H241.def: from «0238»; broadness. i.e. (concrete) the ear (from its form in man):--+ advertise, audience, + displease, ear, hearing, + show.

H242.def: from «0238» and «07609»; plat of Sheerah (i.e. settled by him); Uzzen-Sheerah, a place in Palestine:--Uzzen-sherah.

H243.def: from «0238» and «08396»; flats (i.e. tops) of Tabor (i.e. situated on it); Aznoth-Tabor, a place in Palestine:--Aznoth-tabor.

H244.def: from «0241»; having (quick) ears; Ozni, an Israelite; also an Oznite (collectively), his descendant:--Ozni, Oznites.

H245.def: from «0238» and «03050»; heard by Jah; Azanjah, an Israelite:--Azaniah.

H247.def: a primitive root; to belt:--bind (compass) about, gird (up, with).

H249.et: from (02224) (in the sense of springing up)
H249.def: from «02224» (in the sense of springing up); a spontaneous growth, i.e. native (tree or persons):--bay tree, (home-)born (in the land), of the (one's own) country (nation).

H250.def: patronymic from «02246»; an Ezrachite or descendant of Zerach:--Ezrahite.

H251.def: a primitive word; a brother (used in the widest sense of literal relationship and metaphorical affinity or resemblance (like «01»)):--another, brother(-ly); kindred, like, other. Compare also the proper names beginning with "Ah-" or "Ahi-".

H253.def: a variation for «0162»; Oh! (expressive of grief or surprise):--ah, alas.

H254.def: of uncertain derivation; a fire-pot or chafing dish:-- hearth.

H255.def: probably from «0253»; a howler or lonesome wild animal:--doleful creature.

H256.def: once (by contraction) oEchab (Jer. 29:22) {ekh- awb'}; from «0251» and «01»; brother (i.e. friend) of (his) father; Achab, the name of a king of Israel and of a prophet at Babylon:--Ahab.

H257.def: from «0251» and «0995»; brother (i.e. possessor) of understanding; Achban, an Israelite:--Ahban.

H258.def: perhaps a primitive root; to unify, i.e. (figuratively) collect (one's thoughts):--go one way or other.

H259.def: a numeral from «0258»; properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first:--a, alike, alone, altogether, and, any(-thing), apiece, a certain, (dai-)ly, each (one), + eleven, every, few, first, + highway, a man, once, one, only, other, some, together,

H260.def: of uncertain (perhaps Egyptian) derivation; a bulrush or any marshy grass (particularly that along the Nile):--flag, meadow.

H261.def: from «0258»; united; Echud, the name of three Israelites:--Ehud.

H262.def: from «02331» (in the sense of «02324»); an utterance:-- declaration.

H265.def: by reduplication from «0251»; brotherly; Achoach, an Israelite:--Ahoah.

H266.def: patronymic from «0264»; an Achochite or descendant of Achoach:--Ahohite.

H267.def: perhaps from «0251» and «04325»; brother (i.e. neighbour) of water; Achumai, an Israelite:--Ahumai.

H268.def: or (shortened) achor {aw-khore'}; from «0299»; the hinder part; hence (adverb) behind, backward; also (as facing north) the West:--after(-ward), back (part, -side, -ward), hereafter, (be-)hind(-er part), time to come, without.

H269.def: irregular feminine of «0251»; a sister (used very widely (like «0250»), literally and figuratively):--(an-)other, sister, together.

H270.def: a primitive root; to seize (often with the accessory idea of holding in possession):--+ be affrighted, bar, (catch, lay, take) hold (back), come upon, fasten, handle, portion, (get, have or take) possess(-ion).

H271.def: from «0270»; possessor; Achaz, the name of a Jewish king and of an Israelite:--Ahaz.

H272.def: feminine passive participle from «0270»; something seized, i.e. a possession (especially of land):--possession.

H274.def: or (prolonged) rAchazyahuw {akh-az-yaw'-hoo}; from «0270» and «03050»; Jah has seized; Achazjah, the name of a Jewish and an Israelite king:--Ahaziah.

H276.def: a variation of «0272»; possession; Achuzzath, a Philistine:--Ahuzzath.

H277.def: from «0251»; brotherly; Achi, the name of two Israelites:--Ahi.

H278.def: probably the same as «0277»; Echi, an Israelite:--Ehi.

H279.def: from «0251» and «0517»; brother of the mother (i.e. uncle); Achiam, an Israelite:--Ahiam.

H281.def: or (prolonged) pAchiyahuw {akh-ee-yaw'-hoo}; from «0251» and «03050»; brother (i.e. worshipper) of Jah; Achijah, the name of nine Israelites:--Ahiah, Ahijah.

H282.def: from «0251» and «01935»; brother (i.e. possessor) of renown; Achihud, an Israelite:--Ahihud.

H283.def: prolonged from «0251»; brotherly; Achio, the name of three Israelites:--Ahio.

H284.def: from «0251» and «02330»; brother of a riddle (i.e. mysterious); Achichud, an Israelite:--Ahihud.

H285.def: from «0251» and «02898»; brother of goodness; Achitub, the name of several priests:--Ahitub.

H286.def: from «0251» and «03205»; brother of one born; Achilud, an Israelite:--Ahilud.

H287.def: from «0251» and «04191»; brother of death; Achimoth, an Israelite:--Ahimoth.

H288.def: from «0251» and «04428»; brother of (the) king; Achimelek, the name of an Israelite and of a Hittite:--Ahimelech.

H289.def: or mAchiyman {akh-ee-mawn'}; from «0251» and «04480»; brother of a portion (i.e. gift); Achiman, the name of an Anakite and of an Israelite:--Ahiman.

H290.def: from «0251» and the equivalent of «04619»; brother of anger; Achimaats, the name of three Israelites:--Ahimaaz.

H292.def: from «0251» and «05068»; brother of liberality; Achinadab, an Israelite:--Ahinadab.

H293.def: from «0251» and «05278»; brother of pleasantness; Achinoam, the name of two Israelitesses:--Ahinoam.

H294.def: from «0251» and «05564»; brother of support; Achisamak, an Israelite:--Ahisamach.

H295.def: from «0251» and «05828»; brother of help; Achiezer, the name of two Israelites:--Ahiezer.

H296.def: from «0251» and «06965»; brother of rising (i.e. high); Achikam, an Israelite:--Ahikam.

H297.def: from «0251» and «07311»; brother of height (i.e. high); Achiram, an Israelite:--Ahiram.

H298.def: patronymic from «0297»; an Achiramite or descendant (collectively) of Achiram:--Ahiramites.

H299.def: from «0251» and «07451»; brother of wrong; Achira, an Israelite:--Ahira.
